texture_source_limitations.higher_global_tiff_gi_scope: Natural Earth shaded relief/color land-cover cartography 1 arcminute native raster; not satellite-detail replacement or survey DEM
texture_source_limitations.correction: Initial repository-root library path was wrong; resolved actual app-root library path exists.

shader.normal_relief: Finite-difference uTopo sampled at 1/2048,1/1024; tangential normal perturbation dx*.12,dy*.10. No geometric displacement or separate normal map.
shader.coastline: Land mask inferred from day RGB max(r,g)-b*.70; v004 bounded readability lift from topology gradients. coastlines_50m.geojson registered but not rendered for this one CITY_FOCUS scene.
shader.city_lights: uNight sRGB texture sampled geographic UV; city=max(night.r-night.b*.52,night.g-night.b*.38); pow(max(city-.001,0),.82); nighttime mask + geographic city focus +gain. Block artifact root cause unconfirmed without actual output.
shader.clouds: Two actual sphere cloud shells (4.5km,7.5km) sampled from 8K coverage; time-based geographic drift; opacity governed by lighting. Hero volumetrics retained but not active in this geography preset.
shader.atmosphere: MASTER V3 RGB Rayleigh integration 12x4, view-dependent optical depth, physical atmosphere radius1.0156961R; no distance-adaptive quality LOD.
shader.post: 7 motion-integration samples from HDR target; film tonemap; manual gamma1/2.2; bounded bloom; no new sharpening in v017 non-handoff path.

render_resolution.downscale: 2x per-axis using existing FFmpeg output pipeline
render_resolution.post_aa: None explicitly; MSAA resolved before post + final downsample

LOD.texture_LOD: No higher-resolution regional Earth texture selection; implicit trilinear mip LOD of fixed 8K source.
LOD.terrain_LOD: SphereGeometry512x256 fixed; no terrain geometry LOD
LOD.runtime_downscale_policy: Three WebGLTextures.resizeImage iff width/height > capabilities.maxTextureSize; source image metadata alone does not prove uploaded resolution
